LanguageData.MouseDisaster_VisitorControl_ForcedAway_: Forced expulsion affected {0} visitors. They will withdraw or retaliate according to their incident attitude.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AttitudeTip_Neutral: New arrivals are neutral. Damage does not make the whole group hostile; incident behavior is retained. Forcible expulsion makes that event group hostile. Applies to future occurrences of this incident.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AttitudeTip_Hostile: New arrivals are hostile. Members able to act will assault the colony. Applies to future occurrences of this incident.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AttitudeTip_HostileLeaning: New arrivals are neutral. Actual damage from colonists, colony weapons or turrets makes only that incident's group hostile.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AttitudeTip_FriendlyLeanin: New arrivals are neutral. Colony attacks or forcible expulsion make that event group leave without becoming hostile.
LanguageData.MouseDisaster_AttitudeTip_Friendly: New arrivals are friendly and do not steal colony food. Relief-area food remains available. Colony attacks or forcible expulsion make them leave without becoming hostile.
